limitations: Regex masking can miss unformatted, obfuscated, or nonstandard identifiers. Ordinary numbers are not masked unless they match a phone or order-ID pattern.

masking_patterns.phones: Indian 10-digit mobile numbers, optional +91/91/0 prefix, and international phone numbers with an explicit + country prefix.

name_detection: No customer-name field exists in the source customer data. Free-form names are not reliably detectable by these patterns.
